name: task_integrate
description: Acknowledge durable subagent results after incorporating or explicitly rejecting them. Every delivered task_id must be integrated before a normal final answer.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by task_spawn / task_spawn_batch (or task_retry) of the delivered result being integrated.

disposition.description: How the parent treats the result: 'accepted' = incorporated into the work, 'rejected' = reviewed but deliberately not used, 'superseded' = replaced by a newer attempt or result.

summary.description: What the parent concluded and how it affects the remaining work.
